products.title: Old Rip Van Winkle x Bettinardi Steel Patina 3 Step Jam Putter
products.body_html:
~section 2~

Generations of craft come together in this Old Rip Van Winkle x Bettinardi putter. A 3 Step Jam milled from DASS to 348 grams, it features a rich Steel Patina finish and a wood hex heel inlay sourced from Old Rip Van Winkle bourbon barrels. Featuring a Fancy over Flymill face with a slanted plumber's neck, only 20 were crafted worldwide, making it just as rare as the bourbon that inspired it. products.title: Old Rip Van Winkle x Bettinardi Tour Blast & Wood Grain Copper Face BB0 Putter
products.body_html:
~section 2~

Distinct down to the very last detail, this Old Rip Van Winkle x Bettinardi BB0 reflects the unrelenting commitment to craft both names are known for. Copper face and bumper inserts, polished Tour Blast accents, and a Wood Grain TPT sole carry it from the top shelf to the green with finesse. Crafted from DASS to 353g, it features a Micro Honeycomb face milling and a simple single sightline alignment for performance and feel that match the look. The finest expression of Bettinardi craftsmanship and Old Rip Van Winkle character. Comes completed with a chrome shaft, a Bettinardi Black Gripmaster Perforated Leather Grip, and an Old Rip Van Winkle x Bettinardi Black Felt Blade Putter Headcover, and a black felt bag. Only 7 crafted worldwide. Limit 1 per person.

products.title: Old Rip Van Winkle x Bettinardi Oil Rubbed Bronze BB1 1-of-1 Putter

Finished with an Old Rip Van Winkle x Bettinardi Felt Blade Putter Headcover in brown, a red felt bag, a Black PVD shaft, and a Black/Gray Bettinardi Standard Hex B Grip. Only 1 available, good luck!

products.title: Junior Putter Reshaft
products.body_html:
~section 2~

As your junior golfer grows, their putter can grow with them. Our reshaft service makes it easy to update the length of your Bettinardi Junior Series putter, helping ensure the proper fit through every stage of their game. 

Choose your shaft length and grip and send your putter in to us. One of our professional club builders will install your new shaft and grip and get your putter shipped right back to you. 

This service is available exclusively for Junior Series putters. We will not re-shaft putters made by other manufacturers.  

What’s the process? 

  1. On this page, select a length, then select “Add to Cart.” (Do not check out yet!) 

  1. From our grips page, choose a grip that you want installed on your putter and select “Add To Cart” (A grip MUST be purchased with this order to be processed properly. Bettinardi WILL NOT install a grip not purchased from Bettinardi Golf.) 

  1. Go to your cart and check out. 

  1. You mail your putter along with a printout of your order to our headquarters at: Bettinardi Golf ATTN: Reshaft 7650 Graphics Dr. Tinley Park, IL 60477 

  1. We will reshaft and grip your putter. 

  1. We ship the finished putter to the mailing address on your order. 

*Please note the timeframe of 4-6 weeks (from when we receive your putter) for your reshaft and consider this when entering your mailing address.

products.body_html:

~section 2~

The all-new INOVAI 8.0 was designed and engineered by Sam Bettinardi to instill maximum confidence and forgiveness while putting. The 8.0 was created with a 303 Stainless Steel front piece for a solid feel at impact, and a Military Grade 6061 Aluminum body that was designed with defined wings that offer more stability and higher M.O.I. numbers. The Armlock technique gives golfers more confidence on short putts and consistency on long putts by bracing the 17” grip along the left forearm. With minimal toe hang, one shaft of offset, and a 400 gram head,  it is the perfect mallet for players with a straight-back, straight-through putting stroke, looking to try the PGA Tour proven method.

~section 3~

NEW ROLL CONTROL FACE
Designed from direct Tour feedback, the all-new Roll Control face was scientifically engineered with an asymmetrical design groove profile that creates more topspin at impact, and gets the ball into a true roll faster with each putt.

PREMIUM COMPONENTS
INOVAI Series putters come paired with a carbon fiber Stealth Black mallet headcover and custom 17 inch black Winn Armlock grip.

FRESH APPEARANCE
The 2022 INOVAI Lineup features a fresh look with an all new, Stealth Black anodized 6061 Military Grade Aluminum body, and a Diamond Blast finished 303 Stainless Steel front piece.

MATERIAL
Because we machine all of our putters in our very own manufacturing facility just outside of Chicago, IL, we only use the best materials. A 303 Stainless Steel front piece allows for the feel most requested by PGA Tour players, and a 6061 Military Grade Aluminum body gives our engineers the ability to displace weight out towards the back, resulting in very high M.O.I. numbers.

(Moment of Inertia) mallet designed to maximize stability and forgiveness, ideal for players with a slight to moderate arc in their putting stroke. Its classic full-bodied profile helps maintain stability through impact while ball-width sightlines running down the engine create a clean, confidence-inspiring look at address. 

  • High M.O.I Design: The high-M.O.I. design resists twisting  or turning on off-center strikes, helping the face remain stable through impact. The result is a more consistent roll, tighter distance control, and stability when you need it most.

  • F.I.T. Face™ (Feel Impact Technology): Bettinardi's reengineered F.I.T. Face™ removes 30% of the material from the face for a soft, responsive feel at impact. 

  • Premium Construction: Milled in-house to the exacting standards of tour players, each Antidote delivers unmatched feel and performance.The Hexperimental #2 features a three-piece construction with its 303 Stainless Steel face piece, 6061 Aluminum body and center insert. 

~section 3~

HIGH M.O.I MALLET DESIGN  
Engineered for maximum forgiveness, the high-M.O.I. design resists twisting on off-center strikes to maintain stability through impact. Approximately one-third toe hang complements players with a slight arc in their stroke, while long ball-width sightlines running down the center insert provide a clear visual reference for alignment at address. 

F.I.T. FACE™ (Feel Impact Technology) FACE MILLING
Bettinardi's re-engineered F.I.T. Face™ removes 30% of the face material, resulting in a soft, responsive feel at impact. 

BLACK ARMOR TPT WITH DISTRESSED BLUE
 The Hexperimental #2 has an extremely durable, two-tone Black Armor TPT finish on the topline and body, with Distressed Blue accents on the face and sole and a navy anodized engine.  

PREMIUM COMPONENTS
The Hexperimental #2 comes paired with a matte black shaft, matching Bettinardi Black Hex PU grip in jumbo or standard size, and a Hexperimental Antidote Series magnetic mallet headcover.

products.title: Bettinardi Workshop BB1 Putter
products.body_html:
Model: BB1
Weight: 352g
Material: 303 Stainless Steel
Finish: Black Pearl PVD
Face Milling: Perpetual Fly
Loft: 3°
Lie: 70°
Offset: Full Shaft
Toe Hang: 1/2
Grips: Standard-65g / Jumbo-107g
~section 2~

Engineered for Performance, Styled by You.
Bring your Bettinardi putter to life with the Bettinardi Workshop. Personalize select models with your choice of paint fills, stampings, grip, and headcover. See your setup come together as you build it, then we’ll finish it in our Tinley Park facility with the same precision and care trusted on Tour. The Workshop is your way to add a personal touch—no frills, just pure performance, tailored to you.

Building upon years of American-made craftsmanship, Robert J. Bettinardi has refined his timeless BB1 putter to further enhance its performance. Made in the U.S.A. from a single block of 303 Stainless Steel, the pocket of the new BB1 is milled slightly closer to the heel, resulting in a more balanced center of gravity. Precision-milled to 350 grams with a crowned topline and refreshed bumpers and shoulders, this putter provides players with the perfect optics at address. Our new Perpetual Flymill face milling offers supreme feel and audio feedback and an easily achieved true roll on the green. Through decades of innovating upon a timeless design, the BB1 is RJB’s modern mastery of a classic blade headshape.

All products are made to order. Please allow 6-8 weeks for your Workshop Putter to ship.

~section 3~

CENTER OF GRAVITY SHIFT 
By reshaping the bumpers and shoulders, the Center of Gravity aligns more naturally at address. This enhanced COG establishes a more unified weight distribution, ensuring contact with the sweet spot to achieve a more crisp roll.

PERPETUAL FLYMILL FACE MILLING 
Redefining precision putting, our Bettinardi’s Perpetual Flymill Face Milling technology is now enhanced by sonic precision. This innovative technology provides a consistent roll, ensuring that your putts start true and on target. Each stroke produces a distinctive tone, providing instant feedback to the player.

BLACK PEARL PVD FINISH 
The deep, luxurious black hue of Black Pearl PVD not only exudes sophistication but also adds an extra layer of confidence upon address. Beyond its striking appearance, the PVD coating is highly resistant to wear, scratches, and corrosion.

303 STAINLESS STEEL 
Each BB Series putter is one-piece milled from 303 Stainless Steel, which is the same blend of material preferred by Bettinardi Tour staffers around the globe. This metal offers a more durable, responsive, and solid-feeling putter for supreme performance.

PREMIUM COMPONENTS 
Each BB Series putter comes paired with a Black PVD Tour Grade shaft, custom electric blue Lamkin Grip, and dual-constructed leather and carbon fiber BB Series magnetic headcover.

Two rounds on the championship course at Black Desert, plus a round at Copper Rock in Hurricane, host of the LPGA's Copper Rock Championship.

products.title: Bettinardi Workshop BB49 Putter
products.body_html:
Model: BB-49 
Weight: 355g 
Material: 303 Stainless Steel 
Finish: Savannah Blue 
Face Milling: VDF (Variable Depth Flymill) Face 
Loft: 3 º
Lie: 70 º 
Offset: 3/4 
Toe Hang: 1/3 
Shaft Tip Diameter: .370
~section 2~

The BB-49 Slant is designed for players seeking a compact mallet with moderate arc in their putting stroke. The slant neck design offers slight toe hang and minimal offset at address, creating a gradual flow of the shaft leading into the club head. The BB-49 is engineered with a smooth transition from topline to shoulders that seamlessly melts into the flange. This design distributes weight evenly around the perimeter of the putter head, providing exceptional balance and control. 

All products are made to order. Please allow 8-12 weeks for your Workshop Putter to ship.

~section 3~

New VDF (Variable Depth Flymill) Face: Nine precision-milled zones optimize energy transfer for consistent ball speed and spin across the entire face.

Pure Milled Feel: Precision-milled in the U.S.A. from a single block of 303 Stainless Steel. Delivers crisp haptic feedback, a resonant sound, and responsive performance trusted by Bettinardi Tour staffers worldwide. 

Premium Finish: A striking Savannah Blue PVD finish offers a premium look with long-lasting durability.

products.title: Bettinardi Workshop BB28 Armlock Putter
products.body_html:
Model: BB-28 Armlock
Weight: 400g 
Material: 303 Stainless Steel 
Finish: Savannah Blue 
Face Milling: VDF (Variable Depth Flymill) Face 
Loft: 5 º
Lie: 70 º 
Offset: 1½ 
Toe Hang: 1/8 
Shaft Tip Diameter: .370
~section 2~

The BB-28 Armlock is designed for golfers who prefer added stability in their putting stroke. By resting the grip against the left forearm, players can engage the larger shoulder muscles to power the stroke, minimizing wrist movement for greater consistency. Shaped by direct Tour feedback, the BB-28 Armlock moves away from the slot-back design of the previous model. It features a lower profile with a squared and compact shape for a cleaner, more defined view at address. The BB-28 Armlock is built with a 400-gram head and a standard loft of 5° to optimize the forward press setup of an armlock stroke. 

All products are made to order. Please allow 8-12 weeks for your Workshop Putter to ship.

~section 3~

New VDF (Variable Depth Flymill) Face: Nine precision-milled zones optimize energy transfer for consistent ball speed and spin across the entire face.

Pure Milled Feel: Precision-milled in the U.S.A. from a single block of 303 Stainless Steel. Delivers crisp haptic feedback, a resonant sound, and responsive performance trusted by Bettinardi Tour staffers worldwide. 

Premium Finish: A striking Savannah Blue PVD finish offers a premium look with long-lasting durability.

products.title: Bettinardi Workshop Antidote SB2 Long Putter
products.body_html:
Model: SB2 Long
Weight: 500g 
Material: Face – 303 Stainless Steel / Engine - 303 Stainless Steel / Body – 6061 Aluminum 
Finish: Face - Diamond Blast / Engine - Diamond Blast / Body - Sapphire Blue Anodized 
Face Milling: F.I.T. (Feel Impact Technology) FACE 
Loft: 3 º (Can not change)
Lie: 79 º (Can not change)
Offset: -1 
Toe Hang: -90 º 
Shaft Tip Diameter: .370
~section 2~

The SB2 Long is a Simply Balanced™ zero torque mallet putter, engineered to stay square through impact and deliver unmatched stability and consistency for any stroke type. Paired with a re-engineered 303 Stainless Steel center insert that brings the head weight to 500g and an adjusted 79° lie angle optimizes long-putter performance. Built for players who favor a long putter with a split grip, it provides control and confidence on the greens.  

  • Simply Balanced™: zero torque technology aligns the shaft with the putter head’s center of gravity, keeping the face square for maximum control. 

  • F.I.T. Face™ (Feel Impact Technology): This exclusive face milling removes 55% of the material from the face, for a soft, responsive feel at impact. 

  • Premium Construction: Crafted from the finest metals, milled in the U.S.A. with tour-level precision, and finished for unmatched feel and performance. 

All products are made to order. Please allow 8-12 weeks for your Workshop Putter to ship.

~section 3~

SIMPLY BALANCED™ ZERO-TORQUE TECHNOLOGY
With a precisely engineered 6061 Aluminum body, center insert, and 303 Stainless Face, the SB2’s center of gravity is optimized to promote a zero-torque stroke that stays naturally on path and square from start to finish.

F.I.T. FACE™ (Feel Impact Technology) FACE MILLING  
Milled from 303 Stainless Steel. This exclusive Bettinardi face milling removes 55% of the face material, resulting in a soft, responsive feel.

DIAMOND BLAST AND SAPPHIRE BLUE FINISH  
The Antidote SB2 has a Diamond Blast finish on the face and center insert, and a Sapphire Blue body.
 
PREMIUM COMPONENTS  
This Antidote Series putter is built with a Chrome Tour Grade shaft and comes equipped with a model-specific grip: the Standard model includes a custom matching Lamkin grip, the Counterbalance model features a 17-inch Winn grip, and the Long model is fitted with a Winn 2-piece round grip. Each putter also comes with a premium Antidote Series magnetic mallet headcover.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
 Our Antidote Series putter line-up allows for changes in shaft length and grip configuration without impacting the putter’s zero-torque performance. We do not recommend re-shafting the SB2 model. The engineering behind the design requires the shaft to be inserted directly into the head to achieve zero-torque. Attempting to remove it would require a high level of heat and could potentially damage the finish.

The Hexperimental #9 is a heel-shafted, Simply Balanced™ zero torque blade putter, engineered to stay square through impact and deliver exceptional stability and consistency for any stroke type. Its classic blade profile, minimal onset, and heel-shafted design make it the ideal choice for players who want zero-torque performance with the look and feel of a traditional blade putter. 

  • Simply Balanced™: zero torque technology aligns the shaft with the putter head’s center of gravity, keeping the face square for maximum control. 

  • F.I.T. Face™ (Feel Impact Technology): Bettinardi's re-engineered F.I.T. Face™ removes 30% of the material from the face for a soft, responsive feel at impact. 

  • Premium Construction: Milled in-house from 303 stainless steel to the exacting standards of tour players, each Antidote delivers unmatched feel and performance.

~section 3~

HEEL-SHAFTED SIMPLY BALANCED™ ZERO-TORQUE TECHNOLOGY 
Precision milled from 303 Stainless Steel that features a classic high-toe design and modified plumber's neck, the Hexperimental #9 positions the shaft axis in line with the putter head’s center of gravity. This look achieves minimal onset, and a heel-shafted design that looks and performs like a traditional putter, now with zero torque. 

F.I.T. FACE™ (Feel Impact Technology) FACE MILLING
Bettinardi's re-engineered F.I.T. Face™ removes 30% of the face material, resulting in a soft, responsive feel at impact. 

BLACK ARMOR TPT WITH DISTRESSED BLUE
The Hexperimental #9 has an extremely durable, two-tone Black Armor TPT finish on the topline and body, with Distressed Blue accents on the face and sole. 

PREMIUM COMPONENTS
The Hexperimental #9 comes paired with a matte black shaft, matching Bettinardi Black Hex PU grip in jumbo or standard size, and a Hexperimental Antidote Series magnetic wide blade headcover.

products.body_html:
Model: HLX 6.0 Molten Copper PVD Wedges
Dexterity: Right Hand
Grind: C Grind & RJ Grind
Material: Soft Carbon Steel
Loft/Bounce: 50°/8°/C, 52°/8°/C, 54°/10°/C, 54°/16°/RJ, 56°/12°/C, 56°/16°/RJ, 58°/10°/C, 58°/14°/RJ, 60°/8°/C, 60°/12°/RJ
Wedge Loft: – 1°, – 2°, + 1°, + 2°, No Change (Standard °)

Wedge Shaft: KBS High Rev 2.0, True Temper S200 & S400, or the Nippon Pro Modus 115
Shaft Flex: Stiff
Wedge Grip: Bettinardi Golf Pride Tour Velvet grip

~section 2~

Crafted from premium Soft Carbon Steel, the HLX 6.0 wedges set a new standard in performance and control, elevating your game to its peak. Engineered for golfers demanding precision and versatility, the HLX 6.0 blends cutting-edge innovation with Bettinardi’s legendary craftsmanship. 
 

Finished in Molten Copper PVD and paired with a copper-plated hitting face, this wedge set is designed to naturally patina through play, developing a unique depth and character over time while resisting corrosion. 

*Due to the nature of the finish, color and intensity may vary.  


~section 3~

PRECISION-ENGINEERED TURF INTERACTION
With a refined leading edge on the 4 lower lofted wedges, the HLX 6.0 ensures unparalleled turf interaction. A more squared off leading edge, coupled with reduced offset, offers a seamless connection between the club and the ground, allowing for control and consistency on every shot. 


MASTERY OF SPIN AND LAUNCH
A re-engineered groove geometry, combined with an increased number of grooves, delivers exceptional spin and a precisely controlled launch. This innovation allows golfers to command their short game with the exacting standards synonymous with Bettinardi craftsmanship. 


ELEVATED WORKABILITY AND BALANCE
Designed for the discerning golfer, the higher lofted wedges feature additional heel relief, enhancing workability around the greens. The head weight, reduced by 2 grams, reflects a thoughtful balance that complements the refined golfer’s swing, ensuring an experience that is as effortless as it is effective. 


REFINED ELEGANCE AND PERFORMANCE:
A thinner, beveled top line offers a visual aesthetic that inspires confidence at address. The extended hosel and deeper channel on the back flange subtly shift the center of gravity, resulting in a lowered launch and increased spin. 


MOLTEN COPPER PVD FINISH & COPPER SCORING SURFACE
The Molten Copper PVD finish delivers a refined aesthetic that sets this wedge apart. The copper-plated scoring surface incorporates a corrosion-resistant treatment that allows it to develop a natural patina over time without rusting, ensuring each wedge gains its own distinct character through play.

  • F.I.T. Face™ (Feel Impact Technology): This exclusive face milling removes 55% of the material from the face, for a soft, responsive feel at impact.
  • Premium Construction: Crafted from the finest metals, milled in the U.S.A. with tour-level precision, and finished for unmatched feel and performance.

All products are made to order. Please allow 8-12 weeks for your Workshop Putter to ship.

~section 3~

SIMPLY BALANCED™ ZERO-TORQUE TECHNOLOGY
With a precisely engineered 303 Stainless body and face, the SB3’s Center of Gravity (CoG) lies perfectly at the center of the putter, creating a zero-torque stroke that stays naturally on path and square from start to finish.

F.I.T. FACE™ (Feel Impact Technology) FACE MILLING
Milled from 303 Stainless Steel. This exclusive Bettinardi face milling removes 55% of the face material, resulting in a soft, responsive feel.

DIAMOND BLAST AND SAPPHIRE BLUE FINISH
The Antidote Series showcases Diamond Blast and Sapphire Blue finishes, delivering a refined look with premium durability.

PREMIUM COMPONENTS
This Antidote Series putter comes paired with a Chrome Tour Grade shaft, custom matching Lamkin or Winn Grip, and Antidote Series magnetic headcover.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Our Antidote Series putter line-up allows for changes in shaft length and grip configuration without impacting the putter’s zero-torque performance.

One Piece Co-Forged Solid Body
Engineered to seamlessly co-forge the interior components within the 1025 Carbon Steel chassis, our One Piece Forging Technology delivers a solid body iron with exceptional feel that gives the player responsive feedback.

Tri-Material Construction
The integration of high-density tungsten and military-grade CMC (Ceramic Matrix Composites) within the forged Carbon Steel body produces weight profiles that maximize forgiveness while maintaining balance and consistency from one iron to the next.

Progressive COG Positioning
Loft-dependent positioning of the tungsten and CMC components ensures precise COG placement in each iron. This progressive COG shift generates more launch in the long irons, controlled backspin in the scoring irons, and tighter dispersion while maintaining consistent gapping through the set.

Classic Shape Designed to Perform
A classic-style head shape with a modest aesthetic inspires confidence at address on every shot. The sole of each club is shaped to optimize bounce, ensuring prime turf interaction for effective energy transfer from club to ball.

~section 2~

This Player V Stand Bag, constructed by our friends at Vessel, is here to give you the ultimate carry experience, showcased in a sleek blackout colorway with luxurious quilted fabric, pebbled leather and carbon-embossed material. From the hidden valuables pocket to the beverage compartments, each pocket has been carefully designed and placed to improve organization, accessibility and on-course convenience. The Player V utilizes VESSEL’s patented technologies (Equilibrium Double Strap and Rotator Base) for maximum balance and superior stability. Intentionally placed high strap-attachment points promote further balance and eliminate club fallout while the bag is being carried. A key feature upgrade is the addition of a cart strap pass-through for added protection on a cart or trolley. The Player V showcases signature attention to detail through premium trims and tour-grade materials so you can look and play your best.

products.title: Windy City Wizard UV Blue PVD Combo Iron Set

Crafted for the ultimate playability, the CB24 irons (4-6) are characterized by an optimal progressive cavity and perimeter weighting for maximum MOI, striking a perfect balance of distance and forgiveness. These irons will ship with our True Temper DG Mid 100 S shaft and black Golf Pride Tour Velvet grip at our standard length, loft, and lie. Please reach out to thehive@bettinardi.com for any changes. products.title: The Traveler - Pebble Beach Final Payment
products.body_html:
~section 2~
We’re proud to officially announce the next stop in the Bettinardi Traveler Series — Pebble Beach, one of the most revered golf destinations in the world.

Join us March 26–29, 2026 for three unforgettable rounds at Pebble Beach Golf Links, Spyglass Hill, and Poppy Hills, all while staying in luxury accommodations at The Inn at Spanish Bay.

This exclusive package includes:

✔️ 3 nights at The Inn at Spanish Bay (single or double occupancy)

✔️ 1 round each at Pebble Beach, Spyglass Hill & Poppy Hills

✔️ Bettinardi Traveler’s gift package & exclusive product release

Spots are extremely limited and will go quickly:

  • Single Occupancy – $4,600
  • Double Occupancy – $4,100
  • $2,000 deposit is required to secure your place

  • Remainder Due – An email will be sent to all event participants on January 15, 2026, with details on submitting the remaining balance. Final payment will be due by January 22, 2026.

 

Cancellation Policy: Space is limited, and entries for this event will be available on a first-come, first-served basis through an online release. Entry is non-transferable and exclusively open to BKS members and invited guests. If you can no longer attend, a full refund will be issued if canceled within 15 days of purchase. After that, refunds will not be available unless your spot can be filled from the waiting list.

products.title: Super Bowl LX Champions Seattle Seahawks Limited Run SS28 Putter
products.body_html: Go Hawks! To celebrate the Seahawks' Super Bowl LX victory, we precision machined this Limited Run SS28 from 303 Stainless Steel to 350 grams and finished it with shining Diamond Blast and accenting navy, white, and green paintfill. The sole proudly showcases the Seattle Seahawks logo and "Super Bowl LX" engraved over Micro Honeycomb™, along with the iconic San Francisco Golden Gate Bridge. The fancy face is milled with a repeating "CHAMPIONS" pattern and Bettinardi wordmark on the heel, while the pocket features a "CHAMPIONS" and Seahawks wordmark engraving. This SS28 boasts a triple flangeline alignment, and comes complete with a chrome shaft, Bettinardi Hex B Black Perforated Leather Grip, and a Super Bowl LX Champions Seattle Seahawks Blade Putter Headcover. Available for a limited time only.  This item is a pre-order and will ship between 3-5 weeks. All sales final.*

products.title: The Traveler - England -  Final Payment ($2000 Deposit)
products.body_html:
~section 2~

INVITE ONLY. ALL ORDERS ASSOCIATED WITH A NON-EMAIL FROM INVITE LIST WILL BE REFUNDED!

Get ready to pack the passports. The Traveler is going international for the first time and we are doing it in style 🇬🇧✈️⛳️

 

Trip dates

June 21 to 25, 2026 📅

 

Golf itinerary (the important part)

  • June 22
    • St. George’s Hill
  • June 23
    • Royal St. George’s
  • June 24
    • Sunningdale

Three straight days of bucket list, world top 100, golf 🔥

 

Included in the cost

  • Breakfast on June 22, 23, and 24 🍳
  • Lunch on June 22, 23, and 24
  • Dinner on June 21 and 22🍽️
  • Welcome package 🎁
  • All golf
  • Lodging (Double Room) at Fairmont Windsor Park, Luxury hotel, London
  • Transportation to and from the courses 🚐
  • Optional - two pick-ups on 6/21 from Heathrow and two drop-offs on 6/25 based on flight information provided✈️

 

Cost

  • Total
    • $5,200 
  • Deposit
    • $2,800
  • Remaining
    • Due Early March 2026

 

Notes

  • Walking only at all courses, unless medically cleared to ride 🚶♂️
  • Caddies optional, push carts available
  • Hotel is about 35 minutes from central London
  • June 23 is a free night to explore the city 🌃
  • Release and reception dinner at the hotel on June 21 🍷

 

Cancellation policy

  • Space is limited and spots are first-come, first-served through the online release.
  • Entry is non-transferable and for BKS members and invited guests only.
  • Refunds are only possible if your spot is filled from the waitlist.

products.body_html:
Model: BB48
Weight: 352g
Material: 303 Stainless Steel
Finish: Black Pearl PVD
Face Milling: Perpetual Fly
Loft: 3°
Lie: 70°
Offset: 3/4 Shaft
Toe Hang: 1/3
~section 2~

Through feedback from Tour players seeking a mallet-style putter with a more subtle profile, Sam Bettinardi designed the brand-new BB48. Engineered with sweeping shoulders that dip across the back flange and wane and vanish at the rear, the result is a mallet with a modest appearance that inspires confidence at address. The BB48 features a slant neck with a full shaft of offset for flawless alignment and setup and 1/3 toe hang, making it ideal for golfers with a moderate arc in their stroke. Our new Perpetual Flymill face ensures superior feel, remarkable control, and a consistent roll on every putt.

~section 3~

CENTER OF GRAVITY SHIFT
By reshaping the bumpers and shoulders, the Center of Gravity aligns more naturally at address. This enhanced COG establishes a more unified weight distribution, ensuring contact with the sweet spot to achieve a more crisp roll.

PERPETUAL FLYMILL FACE MILLING
Redefining precision putting, our Bettinardi’s Perpetual Flymill Face Milling technology is now enhanced by sonic precision. This innovative technology provides a consistent roll, ensuring that your putts start true and on target. Each stroke produces a distinctive tone, providing instant feedback to the player.

BLACK PEARL PVD FINISH
The deep, luxurious black hue of Black Pearl PVD not only exudes sophistication but also adds an extra layer of confidence upon address. Beyond its striking appearance, the PVD coating is highly resistant to wear, scratches, and corrosion.

303 STAINLESS STEEL
Each BB Series putter is one-piece milled from 303 Stainless Steel, which is the same blend of material preferred by Bettinardi Tour staffers around the globe. This metal offers a more durable, responsive, and solid-feeling putter for supreme performance.

PREMIUM COMPONENTS
Each BB Series putter comes paired with a Black PVD Tour Grade shaft, custom electric blue Lamkin Grip, and dual-constructed leather and carbon fiber BB Series magnetic headcover.

Showcasing our Lucky Cat and T-Hive, this bag is finished with a white, gray and black colorway, with bright green accents. From the hidden valuables pocket to the beverage compartments, each pocket has been carefully designed and placed to improve organization, accessibility and on-course convenience. A key feature upgrade is the addition of a cart strap pass-through for added protection on a cart or trolley.
